item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang gcod yid bzhin nor bu'i zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las
item.coloph: zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sgrab pa 'di/ khams kyi byang na skyes pa'i be ri khro gnyan la/ bla chen dran pa nam mkhas lung bstan nas/ bla ma'i gsungs bzhin 'gro ba'i don du yi ger bkod/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ snyan rgyud thams cad kyi yang bcud gcig tu bsdus pa/ phyi nang lha rnams gcig rdzogs kyi sgrub pa rdzogs so//
